physical_baseline.result: exact repository bitstream, enumeration, driver binding, basic and concurrent DMA, full 4 GiB chunked comparison, AER/path stability, and cleanup passed
physical_baseline.scope_note: The RC4 wrapper returned 0 natively after the post-cleanup kernel gate; its returned evidence archive and all 100 internally listed files passed SHA-256 verification.

power_topology.pcie_and_3v3: Thunderbolt/USB4 M.2 enclosure -> M.2 slot -> M.2-to-PCIe adapter -> board PCIe and 3.3 V rails
power_topology.12v: dedicated USB-C PD source -> trigger module configured and negotiated to 12 V -> adapter auxiliary +12 V and return/GND input -> board PCIe 12 V input rail
power_topology.validated_sequence: both rails were stable before Windows JTAG SRAM programming and remained present through host reboot and the native-Ubuntu RC4 regression; relative rail order was not isolated
power_topology.unmeasured_boundary: auxiliary connector pinout/polarity, powered-off ground continuity, reverse current, single-source power states, current ratings, and startup/steady current were not publicly measured; hot-plug operation is not claimed
